bias.en: Downtrend · new low at $148.80, closed off the lows
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 创新低 $148.80 后收于高位

read.en: Nvidia fell 4.3% on Nov 12 to $166.19, trading $148.80–167.14 on very heavy volume (4.47x the 20-day average); the low is a new 52-week low. It is below the 5-day ($174.8), 10-day ($186.9), 30-day ($210.9), 100-day ($212.6) and 200-day ($204.3), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($185.05), and RSI is 26.0, oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月12日下跌 4.3%，收于 $166.19，盘中区间 $148.80–167.14，成交量大幅放大（20 日均量的 4.47 倍）；盘中低点创 52 周新低。股价位于 5 日（$174.8）、10 日（$186.9）、30 日（$210.9）、100 日（$212.6）和 200 日均线（$204.3）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$185.05），RSI 为 26.0，处于超卖。

read.en: The drop broke the $170.2–170.8 support (Nov 9 and 11 lows), now resistance, and the $164.27 Mar 30 low intraday; the close recovered near the high. Resistance is $167.1–170.8, then $174.8–177.5 (5-day, Nov 11 high) and $185 (SAR). Support is $164.3–165.9 (Mar 30 and Nov 10 lows), then $160 and $148.8 (52-week low). A close above $170.8 would target $175–177.5; below $164.3, $160.

r.en: Nov 12 high $167.14; Nov 9 low $170.24 and Nov 11 low $170.77, broken
